name: random.seed
differs: Does not accept the argument version, which Python 3.14 has (a TypeError).
Checked against Python 3.14 by its signature and examples, not reviewed line by line.

name: random.randint
differs: On some values it raises AttributeError where Python 3.14 raises TypeError, e.g. randint('', 2).
Found by a probe of edge values against Python 3.14.8 (scripts/catalog-probe.py; catalog/python/probes/stdlib.json).

name: random.choice

differs: Gives Python 3.14.8's answer on a probe of edge values of each argument (scripts/catalog-probe.py; catalog/python/probes/stdlib.json), and accepts every argument of its signature; not reviewed line by line.
